camel_example: aliyun mts AddSmarttagTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --Industry common --TemplateName 'template-example-0000' --AnalyseTypes ocr --Scene search
description_en: Adds an analysis template for a smart tagging job
description_zh: 添加一个智能标签作业的分析模板
kebab_example: aliyun mts add-smarttag-template --template-name template-example-0000 --industry common --scene search --analyse-types ocr --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddSmarttagTemplate

parameters.help_en: The custom template name. The name can contain Chinese and English characters and must be up to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义模板名称，字符串内容中英文不限，最长120字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The industry of the file to be analyzed. Default value: common (general industry). Select an appropriate industry so that the system can match the algorithm combinations suitable for the industry in the background. Valid values: 

microVideo: short video industry.
common: general industry
parameters.help_zh:
待分析文件所处行业。默认值：common（通用行业）。请选择合适的行业，用于后台匹配适用于行业的算法组合。取值： 

microVideo：小视频行业。
common：通用行业
parameters.name: industry

parameters.help_en:
The scenarios of the file to be analyzed. Select appropriate scenarios so that the system can match the applicable algorithm combinations in the background. Valid values:

search: search scenario.
recommend: recommendation scenario.

Default value: search
parameters.help_zh:
待分析文件使用场景。请选择合适的使用场景，用于后台匹配适用的算法组合。取值：

search：搜索场景。
recommend：推荐场景。

默认值：search
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en:
The analysis types. You can select multiple types and separate them with commas (,). The following types are supported: 
Make sure that the file to be analyzed contains the results of the selected analysis types. Otherwise, the query result may be empty. For example, if you select ocr as the analysis type but the uploaded image does not contain OCR results, an empty result is returned.

ocr: recognizes labels from text in images.
asr: recognizes labels from audio speech.
classification: video categorization.
shows: recognizes TV shows in videos.
face: recognizes faces in videos or images.
role: recognizes character roles in videos.
object: recognizes objects in videos.
tvstation: recognizes TV station logos in videos.
action: recognizes action events in videos.
emotion: recognizes facial expressions in videos.
landmark: recognizes landmarks in videos.
scene: recognizes scenarios in videos.
movieIp: recognizes movie IPs in videos. This type is currently supported only in the China (Beijing) region.
subtitle: caption fetch feature.

The mapping between analysis types and billable items is as follows:

Fees are generated for the analysis types enabled by configuring the smart tagging feature through this operation. For billing standards, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/299952.html.

Video categorization and structured labels: All analysis types except face, ocr, and asr belong to this billable item. Fees are not accumulated.
Video face recognition: enabled when face is selected.
Video text recognition labels: enabled when ocr is selected.
Video speech recognition labels: enabled when asr is selected
parameters.help_zh:
分析类型，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔。当前有以下类型： 
请确保您的待分析文件中包含所选分析类型的结果，否则可能导致查询结果为空。例如：选择的分析类型为ocr，但上传的图片中没有ocr结果，则查询时返回结果为空。

ocr：从图像⽂字中识别出标签 。
asr：从⾳频语⾳中识别出标签 。
classification：视频分类 。
shows：视频识别节⽬ 。
face：视频或图片识别⼈脸 。
role：视频识别⼈物⻆⾊ 。
object：视频识别物体 。
tvstation：视频识别台标。
action：视频识别动作事件 。
emotion：视频识别表情 。
landmark：视频识别地标 。
scene：视频识别场景。
movieIp：视频识别影视IP，目前仅支持华北2（北京）地域使用。
subtitle：字幕提取功能。

分析类型与计费项的对应关系如下：

通过本接口配置智能标签功能开启的分析类型，将会产生费用，收费标准请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/299952.html。

视频分类+结构化标签：除face，ocr，asr外的分析类型均属于此计费项，不叠加计费。
视频人脸识别：开启face。
视频文字识别标签：开启ocr。
视频语音识别标签：开启asr
parameters.name: analyse_types

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the face libraries used for recognition. You can select multiple IDs and separate them with commas (,). You can specify system face library IDs and custom face library IDs. The system face library IDs are as follows:

celebrity: celebrities.
politician: political figures.
sensitive: sensitive figures.

For custom face library IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187777.html
parameters.help_zh:
参与识别的⼈脸库ID列表，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔。可填⼊系统⼈脸库ID和⾃定义⼈脸库ID。其中系统⼈脸库ID如下：

celebrity：明星⼈物。
politician：政治⼈物。
sensitive：敏感⼈物。

⾃定义⼈物库ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187777.html
parameters.name: face_category_ids

parameters.help_en:
The parameters of the face algorithm in JSON string format. Currently, you can adjust the face detection threshold and face recognition threshold.

faceDetThreshold: the face detection threshold. The default value is 0.999. This parameter takes effect only for unknown face analysis.

faceRegThreshold: the face recognition threshold. The default value is 0.9
parameters.help_zh:
人脸算法的参数，JSON String形式，目前支持人脸检测阈值和人脸识别阈值调整。

faceDetThreshold：人脸检测阈值，默认阈值0.999，只对陌生人脸分析有效。

faceRegThreshold：人脸识别阈值，默认阈值0.9
parameters.name: face_custom_params_config

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the object libraries used for recognition. You can select multiple IDs and separate them with commas (,). You can specify system object library IDs and custom object library IDs. The system object library IDs are as follows:

general: general.

item: commodities.

weapon: weapons.

animal: animals.

For custom object library IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451180.html
parameters.help_zh:
参与识别的物体库ID列表，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔。可填⼊系统物体库ID和⾃定义物体库ID。其中系统物体库ID如下：

general：通用。

item：商品。

weapon：武器。

animal：动物。

⾃定义物体库ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451180.html接口说明
parameters.name: object_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the landmark libraries used for recognition. You can select multiple IDs and separate them with commas (,). You can specify system landmark library IDs and custom landmark library IDs. The system landmark library IDs are as follows:

common: general.

For custom landmark library IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451182.html
parameters.help_zh:
参与识别的地域库ID列表，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔。可填⼊系统地域库ID和⾃定义地域库ID。其中系统地域库ID如下：

common：通用。

⾃定义地域库ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451182.html接口说明
parameters.name: landmark_group_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to set the template as the default template. If the template is set as the default template and no transcoding template is specified during transcoding, the default template is used. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false. An Alibaba Cloud account can have only one default template. An error is reported if you set multiple default templates
parameters.help_zh: 是否设置为默认模板（设置为默认模板后，如果转码时不指定转码模板则使用默认模板进行转码）。取值：true（是）、false（否），默认false。⼀个阿里云账号下只能有⼀个默认模板，如果重复设置则会报错
parameters.name: is_default

parameters.help_en:
The tagging type. The following types are supported:

auto: machine tagging.

hmi: human-machine collaboration
parameters.help_zh:
标注类型，目前支持类型：

auto：机器打标。

hmi：人机协同
parameters.name: label_type

parameters.help_en:
The smart tagging version. Default value: 1.0. Valid values:

1.0: Smart Tagging 1.0.

2.0: Smart Tagging 2.0 (CPV tags).

2.0-custom: Smart Tagging 2.0-custom (custom model for CPV tags)
parameters.help_zh:
指定智能标签版本，默认为"1.0"。

1.0：智能标签1.0

2.0：智能标签2.0（CPV标签）

2.0-custom：智能标签2.0-custom（CPV标签定制模型）
parameters.name: label_version

parameters.help_en:
The scope of knowledge graph information fields recognized in the returned tag results in Smart Tagging 2.0 and 2.0-custom modes. For more information about knowledge graph information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356383.html. If this parameter is not specified, is empty, or is invalid (not a JSON string), the following fields are returned by default:

movie:

    - name: the IP name.

    - alias: the IP alias.
    - chnl: the category.
    - genre: the genre.
    - country: the producing country or region.
    - language: the language.
    - releaseYear: the release year.

music:

    - songName: the song name.
    - artistName: the artist name.
    - artistArea: the region of the artist, such as Chinese, Japanese, Korean, European and American, or other.
    - albumName: the album name.

person:

    - name: the name.
    - gender: the gender.
    - citizenship: the citizenship.
    - occupation: the occupation.
    - classification: the classification.
    - nationality: the nationality.
    - birthPlace: the birthplace.
    - birthDate: the birth date.

landmark:
    - name: the name.
    - nameEn: the English name.
    - description: the description.
    - address: the address.

item:

    - brandName: the brand name.
    - finegrainName: the fine-grained description
parameters.help_zh:
智能标签2.0和2.0-custom模式下，设置返回标签结果中识别到知识图谱信息字段范围。更多知识图谱信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356383.html。不填写或者knowledgeConfig为空或者knowledgeConfig非法（不为JSON String）时，默认输出以下字段：

movie：

    - name：IP名称

    - alias：IP别名
    - chnl：类别
    - genre：类型
    - country：制片国家、地区
    - language：语言
    -  releaseYear：发布年份

music：

    - songName：歌曲名称
    - artistName：歌手姓名
    - artistArea：歌手所属地区，华语/日本/韩国/欧美/其他
    - albumName：专辑名称

person：

    - name：姓名
    - gender：性别
    - citizenship：国籍
    -  occupation：职业
    - classification：类型
    - nationality：民族
    - birthPlace：出生地
    - birthDate：出生日期

landmark
    - name：名称
    - nameEn：英文名
    - description：描述
    - address：地址

item

    - brandName：品牌
    - finegrainName：细粒度描述
parameters.name: knowledge_config

parameters.help_en:
The keyword tag configuration. The type field specifies the part-of-speech categories. You can select multiple categories and separate them with commas (,). The following categories are supported:

name: person name.

location: location name.

organization: organization name.

other: other.

If KeywordConfig is not passed, the Keyword field is invalid (not a JSON string), KeywordsConfig does not contain the type field, or the type field is invalid, keywords of all types are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
关键词标签配置。type代表词性类别选择，可多选，用半角逗号（,）分隔，当前支持以下类别：

name：人名

location：地名

organization：机构名

other：其他

当不传KeywordConfig时或者Keyword字段非法（不为JSON String）或者KeywordsConfig不包含type字段或者type字段非法时默认返回type全部类型关键词
parameters.name: keyword_config

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the custom tag libraries used for recognition. You can select multiple IDs and separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 参与识别的自定义标签库ID列表，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: label_custom_category_ids

parameters.help_en:
The parameter settings for additional custom label libraries. Currently, only threshold settings are supported.
{"threshold": xxx}
parameters.help_zh:
额外自定义标签库的参数配置，目前只支持阈值的设置。
{"threshold": xxx}
parameters.name: label_custom_params_config

parameters.help_en: The smart tagging template configuration, passed as a JSON string. Configuration items include the industry, scenarios, and analysis types. The passed configuration items overwrite the corresponding original configurations in the template
parameters.help_zh: 智能标签模板配置，使用 JSON 字符串传入。配置项包括行业、使用场景和分析类型等。传入的配置项会覆盖模板中对应的原有配置
parameters.name: template_config

TemplateId.description_en: The template ID. We recommend that you save this ID for subsequent calls to other related operations
TemplateId.description_zh: 模板ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续调用其他相关接口时使用
